name: Hutter & Schrantz Stahlbau AG
summary: Hutter & Schrantz Stahlbau AG operates as a steel construction company in Central Europe. It offers its services in Germany, Austria, Hungary, France, Portugal, Britain, Switzerland, and the Benelux countries, as well as in Ukraine, Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Slovenia, and Croatia. The company is based in Vienna, Austria.
